item.title: Alexandre de Betak’s Light Installation in Gstaad
item.description: Set in the Bernese Oberland, near Gstaad, multi-talented designer Alexandre de Betak transformed a modest Alpine farm shed, half-buried in snow, into a meditative encounter with light, reflection, and space. The post Alexandre de Betak’s Light Installation in Gstaad appeared first on TLmagazine.

item.title: Glass: Transcending Matter. The Cirva Collection
item.description: Running from November 8, 2025 to March 15, 2026, Glass: Transcending Matter. The Cirva Collections at the Musée d'Art Moderne et Contemporain de Saint-Étienne Métropole (MAMC+) offers an ambitious presentation of Cirva's collections to date. The exhibition draws a rich dialogue between design, visual arts, and scientific inquiry through the singular lens of glass. The post Glass: Transcending Matter. The Cirva Collection appeared first on TLmagazine.

item.title: Zaventem Ateliers Takes Over Villa Empain
item.description: For ten days, Villa Empain becomes a living ecosystem of Belgian contemporary collectible design and art, with 32 designers and artists from Zaventem Ateliers taking over the historic building. The post Zaventem Ateliers Takes Over Villa Empain appeared first on TLmagazine.

item.title: Zhuo Tan Talks to TLmag About Design Shanghai 2026
item.description: Just ahead of the opening of the 13th edition of Design Shanghai, we spoke to Zhuo Tan, Co-Founder and Event Director of Design Shanghai, to learn about the history of this prestigious design event, its support of contemporary Chinese design, and what she is looking forward to seeing realised this year during the 4-day event. item.description: On Saturday, March 14th, Belgian textile designer Vera Vermeersch will open her studio between 12-20h, offering visitors the opportunity to see her latest work, works-in progress, and have a unique glimpse into this prolific artist's process and vision. item.title: Collecting and Legacy: Staffan Ahrenberg in Conversation with Simon de Pury
item.description: For our 2026 print issue: TLmag41: The Art of Collecting, Simon de Pury interviewed Steffan Ahrenberg, owner and publisher of Cahiers d'Art, the iconic publishing house and gallery that celebrates 100 years in 2026. As part of their 100th anniversary, there will be a host of exhibitions and events in various institutions including the Peggy Guggenheim Museum in Venice and MoMA, NY.
